1: # MassWorld
2: 
3: MassWorld 正在设计为一套面向世界模型、具身策略和 Agent 系统的统一运行与评测平台。
4: 
5: 当前架构讨论从以下文档开始：
6: 
7: - [世界模型统一运行与评测平台设计](./docs/architecture/unified-evaluation-platform/README.md)
8: - [统一 Benchmark 评测平台定义](./docs/architecture/unified-evaluation-platform/platform-definition.md)
9: - [评测级日志、Trace 与证据架构](./docs/architecture/unified-evaluation-platform/evaluation-grade-logging.md)
10: - [Benchmark 评测运行泳道与流程](./docs/architecture/unified-evaluation-platform/evaluation-run-swimlane.md)
11: - [目标架构草案](./docs/architecture/unified-evaluation-platform/architecture.md)
12: - [分阶段落地路线](./docs/architecture/unified-evaluation-platform/roadmap.md)
13: - [待确认问题](./docs/architecture/unified-evaluation-platform/open-questions.md)
14: 
15: 核心方向是建设统一控制平面，复用 qzcli 与现有算力基础设施，并让模型部署、Agent/仿真运行、评测和审计共享同一套版本身份与证据链。
16: 
17: ## WorldEvalKit
18: 
19: WorldEvalKit 是世界模型评测框架，提供统一的模型与 Benchmark 接入、
20: 评测任务编排和结果记录。模块代码位于 `WorldEvalKit/`，
21: 使用方式与扩展说明见 [WorldEvalKit 文档](WorldEvalKit/README.md)。

80: def _port_matches(offered: Port, required: Port) -> bool:
81:     constraints, _ = _constraints_match(offered.constraints, required.constraints)
82:     return (
83:         offered.semantic == required.semantic
84:         and offered.type_id == required.type_id
85:         and offered.many == required.many
86:         and constraints
87:     )

135:     input_mapping: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
136:     output_mapping: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
137: ) -> Binding:
138:     selected = endpoint or benchmark.endpoint
139:     endpoints: Iterable[Endpoint] = (
140:         (model.endpoint(selected),) if selected else model.endpoints.values()
141:     )

143:     failures: list[str] = []
144:     for candidate in endpoints:
145:         if candidate.protocol != benchmark.protocol:
146:             failures.append(
147:                 f"{candidate.id}: protocol {candidate.protocol} != {benchmark.protocol}"
148:             )
149:             continue
150:         constraints, reason = _constraints_match(
151:             candidate.constraints,
152:             dict(benchmark.metadata.get("endpoint_constraints", {})),
153:         )
154:         if not constraints:
155:             failures.append(f"{candidate.id}: {reason}")
156:             continue
157:         inputs, input_errors = _bind_ports(
158:             candidate.inputs,
159:             benchmark.inputs,
160:             dict(input_mapping or {}),
161:             direction="input",
162:         )
163:         outputs, output_errors = _bind_ports(
164:             candidate.outputs,
165:             benchmark.outputs,
166:             dict(output_mapping or {}),
167:             direction="output",
168:         )
169:         supplied = set(inputs.values())
170:         missing = [
171:             name
172:             for name, port in candidate.inputs.items()
173:             if port.required and name not in supplied
174:         ]
175:         errors = [*input_errors, *output_errors]
176:         if missing:
177:             errors.append("required endpoint inputs are unbound: " + ", ".join(missing))
178:         if errors:
179:             failures.append(f"{candidate.id}: " + "; ".join(errors))
180:             continue
181:         matches.append(Binding(candidate.id, inputs, outputs))
182:     if not matches:
183:         raise ValueError("; ".join(failures) or "model has no compatible endpoint")
184:     if len(matches) > 1:
185:         raise ValueError(
186:             "multiple endpoints match: "
187:             + ", ".join(item.endpoint for item in matches)
188:             + "; select one explicitly"
189:         )
190:     return matches[0]

25: @dataclass(frozen=True)
26: class EpisodeConfig:
27:     max_steps: int
28:     observation_inputs: Mapping[str, str]
29:     action_outputs: tuple[str, ...]
30:     parameters: Mapping[str, Any]
31: 
32:     def __post_init__(self) -> None:
33:         if self.max_steps <= 0 or not self.action_outputs:
34:             raise ValueError("episodes require positive max_steps and action outputs")
35:

51:     def run(self, case: Case) -> ArtifactBundle:
52:         trace: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
53:         try:
54:             observation = self.environment.reset(case)
55:             for step in range(self.config.max_steps):
56:                 inputs = {}
57:                 for (
58:                     model_input,
59:                     observation_output,
60:                 ) in self.config.observation_inputs.items():
61:                     if observation_output not in observation.outputs:
62:                         raise ValueError(
63:                             f"observation is missing {observation_output!r} for "
64:                             f"model input {model_input!r}"
65:                         )
66:                     inputs[model_input] = observation.outputs[observation_output]
67:                 request = Request(
68:                     id=stable_hash([case.id, step, self.config.parameters])[:24],
69:                     case_id=case.id,
70:                     endpoint=self.endpoint.id,
71:                     inputs=inputs,
72:                     outputs=self.config.action_outputs,
73:                     parameters={**dict(self.config.parameters), "step": step},
74:                 )
75:                 action = self.model.invoke(request)
76:                 transition = self.environment.step(action)
77:                 trace.append(
78:                     {
79:                         "step": step,
80:                         "observation": observation.to_dict(),
81:                         "action": action.to_dict(),
82:                         "transition": transition.to_dict(),
83:                     }
84:                 )
85:                 observation = transition.observation
86:                 if transition.terminated or transition.truncated:
87:                     break
88:         finally:
89:             self.environment.close()
90:         final = trace[-1]["transition"] if trace else {}
91:         return ArtifactBundle(
92:             case_id=case.id,
93:             outputs={
94:                 "episode_trace": Artifact(
95:                     "core.episode_trace",
96:                     data=trace,
97:                     metadata={
98:                         "steps": len(trace),
99:                         "terminated": bool(final.get("terminated")),
100:                         "truncated": bool(final.get("truncated")),
101:                     },
102:                 )
103:             },
104:             provenance={"runner": "episode", "max_steps": self.config.max_steps},
105:         )

9: @dataclass(frozen=True)
10: class Retry:
11:     attempts: int = 1
12:     backoff_seconds: float = 0.0
13:     on: tuple[str, ...] = ()
14: 
15:     def __post_init__(self) -> None:
16:         if self.attempts < 1 or self.backoff_seconds < 0:
17:             raise ValueError("retry attempts must be positive and backoff non-negative")
18: 
19:     @classmethod
20:     def from_value(cls, value: "Retry | Mapping[str, Any] | None") -> "Retry":
21:         if isinstance(value, cls):
22:             return value
23:         data = dict(value or {})
24:         if "max_attempts" in data:
25:             data["attempts"] = data.pop("max_attempts")
26:         if "retryable_errors" in data:
27:             data["on"] = data.pop("retryable_errors")
28:         data["on"] = tuple(str(item) for item in data.get("on", ()))
29:         return cls(**data)

54: class Artifact:
55:     """One typed value or immutable resource reference."""

69:         if (self.uri is None) == (self.data is None):
70:             raise ValueError("Artifact requires exactly one of uri or data")

109: @dataclass(frozen=True)
110: class Port:
111:     """A named-port contract. Strings are accepted through :func:`parse_ports`."""
112: 
113:     type_id: str
114:     semantic: str = ""
115:     many: bool = False
116:     required: bool = True
117:     schema: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
118:     constraints: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
119:     description: str | None = None
120: 
121:     def __post_init__(self) -> None:
122:         object.__setattr__(self, "type_id", validate_type_id(self.type_id))
123:         object.__setattr__(self, "semantic", str(self.semantic).strip())
124:         try:
125:             validator = jsonschema.validators.validator_for(self.schema)
126:             validator.check_schema(self.schema)
127:         except jsonschema.SchemaError as error:
128:             raise ValueError(f"invalid JSON Schema: {error.message}") from error
129: 
130:     @property
131:     def cardinality(self) -> str:
132:         return "many" if self.many else "one"
133: 
134:     def validate(self, value: ArtifactValue, *, name: str) -> None:
135:         if self.many and not isinstance(value, tuple):
136:             raise ValueError(f"{name} requires multiple artifacts")
137:         if not self.many and isinstance(value, tuple):
138:             raise ValueError(f"{name} requires one artifact")
139:         artifacts = value if isinstance(value, tuple) else (value,)
140:         if self.required and not artifacts:
141:             raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty")
142:         for artifact in artifacts:
143:             if artifact.type_id != self.type_id:
144:                 raise TypeError(
145:                     f"{name} requires {self.type_id}, got {artifact.type_id}"
146:                 )
147:             if self.schema and artifact.data is not None:
148:                 try:
149:                     jsonschema.validate(artifact.data, self.schema)
150:                 except jsonschema.ValidationError as error:
151:                     raise ValueError(f"{name}: {error.message}") from error

229:     def run(
230:         self,
231:         command: Sequence[str],
232:         *,
233:         cwd: str | Path | None,
234:         log_dir: str | Path,
235:         name: str,
236:         environment: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
237:         timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
238:         on_progress=None,
239:     ) -> CommandResult:
240:         timeout = timeout_seconds if timeout_seconds is not None else self.runtime.options.get("timeout_seconds")
241:         if timeout is not None and float(timeout) <= 0:
242:             raise ValueError("timeout_seconds must be positive")
243:         service = self.start(command, cwd=cwd, log_dir=log_dir, name=name, environment=environment, on_progress=on_progress)
244:         try:
245:             deadline = None if timeout is None else service.started + float(timeout)
246:             while True:
247:                 if service.progress_reader is not None:
248:                     service.progress_reader.poll()
249:                 if self._cancelled.is_set():
250:                     raise RuntimeError("runtime cancelled")
251:                 remaining = None if deadline is None else deadline - time.monotonic()
252:                 if remaining is not None and remaining <= 0:
253:                     raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(command, float(timeout))
254:                 try:
255:                     service.process.wait(timeout=0.2 if remaining is None else min(0.2, remaining))
256:                     break
257:                 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
258:                     continue
259:             result = service.result()
260:             if result.returncode:
261:                 raise CommandFailed(f"command failed with exit code {result.returncode}; see {result.stderr}")
262:             return result
263:         except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
264:             raise TimeoutError(f"command timed out after {timeout}s") from error
265:         finally:
266:             try:
267:                 service.close()
268:             finally:
269:                 if service.progress_reader is not None:
270:                     service.progress_reader.poll()

1: # 目标架构草案
2: 
3: ## 1. 架构判断
4: 
5: 平台应围绕一条共享“身份与证据主干”构建：
6: 
7: ```text
8: 模型来源
9:   → ModelVersion（代码 + 权重 + 环境 + 配置）
10:   → Deployment / WorkflowVersion
11:   → Run / Episode / Step
12:   → Event / Trace / Artifact
13:   → Metric / Scorecard / EvidenceBundle
14: ```
15: 
16: 如果部署、Agent、日志和评测分别维护自己的模型 ID、任务 ID 和版本字段，最终会把大量时间花在跨系统对账上。统一平台的首要价值不是统一 UI，而是让上述 lineage 从一开始就是同一条链。

88: ### 2.3 qzcli Provider
89: 
90: 当前机器上的 qzcli 0.3.0 已提供：
91: 
92: - `create`：镜像、命令、workspace/project、计算组、GPU 规格、实例数、共享内存、数据集挂载；
93: - `status`、`watch`、`track`：任务状态；
94: - `logs`：按 pod、时间和 tail 获取日志；
95: - `stop`：停止任务；
96: - `exec` / `exec-attach`：开发机内执行与重连；
97: - `batch`：批量提交。
98: 
99: 平台不应把 qzcli 命令散落在评测代码中，应由一个 provider adapter 封装：
100: 
101: ```python
102: class ExecutionProvider:
103:     def submit(spec: ProviderJobSpec) -> ProviderJobRef: ...
104:     def inspect(job: ProviderJobRef) -> ProviderJobStatus: ...
105:     def stream_logs(job: ProviderJobRef, cursor: str | None) -> LogBatch: ...
106:     def cancel(job: ProviderJobRef) -> None: ...
107:     def exec(job: ProviderJobRef, command: list[str]) -> ExecResult: ...
108: ```
109: 
110: 还需要确认 qzcli/底层平台是否具备持续服务所需能力：
111: 
112: - 端口暴露和 endpoint 发现；
113: - readiness/liveness probe；
114: - 版本切流、滚动升级和回滚；
115: - service credential/secret 注入；

214: ## 3. 核心契约
215: 
216: 第一阶段最值得先稳定的不是数据库表，而是以下可序列化契约：
217: 
218: 1. `ModelVersionRef`
219: 2. `RuntimeSpec`
220: 3. `DeploymentSpec` / `DeploymentRef`
221: 4. `CapabilityContract`
222: 5. `EvaluationProtocol`
223: 6. `EvaluationPlan`
224: 7. `RunResult` / `EpisodeTrace` / `StepTrace`
225: 8. `ArtifactRef`
226: 9. `MetricResult`
227: 10. `Scorecard` / `EvidenceBundle`
228: 
229: 每个契约都应包含 `schema_version`，支持 JSON 往返，并使用不可变版本引用。

140: class CanonicalModel:
141:     def __init__(self, family, options, output, entry):
142:         self.original = entry.describe(options)
143:         self.cap = capability(family, options, self.original)
144:         self.paths = profile_paths(options["io_profile"], self.original)
145:         self.engine = entry.factory(options, output)
146: 
147:     def begin_episode(self, context, task, profile, space):
148:         self.profile = profile
149:         inputs = {req.key: "model/drive_targets" if req.key == "drive_targets" else self.paths[req.key].split(".", 1)[1]
150:                   for req in self.original.inputs}
151:         bound = native.BoundProfile(profile_id=profile.profile_id, model_id=profile.model_id, space_ref=profile.space_ref,
152:             warnings=profile.warnings, binding=native.BindingConfig(inputs=inputs, targets=public_targets(self.original),
153:                 action_spec_ref=profile.action_spec_ref, frame_conversions=profile.frame_conversions))
154:         self.engine.begin_episode(native_context(context), task, bound, private_space(space, self.original, self.paths))
155: 
156:     def observe(self, model_input):
157:         self.engine.observe(private_input(model_input, self.original, self.paths))
158: 
159:     def predict(self, context):
160:         result = self.engine.predict(native_context(context))
161:         return c.Prediction(context=context, based_on_observation_id=result.based_on_observation_id,
162:             action=result.action,
163:             model_forward_count=result.model_forward_count,
164:             transformations=result.transformations + ("canonical-v03-to-weight-private-encoding",))
165: 
166:     def end_episode(self, context):
167:         self.engine.end_episode(native_context(context))
168: 
169:     def diagnostics(self):
170:         return dict(self.engine.diagnostics(), public_contract_version="0.3", model_private_codec_only=True)
171: 
172:     def close(self):
173:         self.engine.close()

145: class CanonicalBenchmark:
146:     def __init__(self, family, options, output, entry):
147:         self.family = family
148:         self.engine = entry.factory(options, output)
149:         self.latest = None
150:         try:
151:             self.describe()
152:         except Exception:
153:             self.engine.close()
154:             raise
155: 
156:     def describe(self):
157:         self.native_space = self.engine.describe()
158:         self.space = canonical_space(self.family, self.native_space)
159:         return self.space
160: 
161:     def enumerate_tasks(self, episodes):
162:         return [c.TaskSpec(**{f.name: getattr(task, f.name) for f in fields(c.TaskSpec) if f.name != "contract_version"})
163:                 for task in self.engine.enumerate_tasks(episodes)]
164: 
165:     def reset(self, task, context):
166:         old = native.TaskSpec(**{f.name: getattr(task, f.name) for f in fields(native.TaskSpec) if f.name != "contract_version"})
167:         result = self.engine.reset(old, native_context(context))
168:         self.latest = canonical_observation(self.family, self.native_space, result, self.space)
169:         return self.latest
170: 
171:     def advance(self, action, context, remaining):
172:         from .transforms import action_for_environment
173:         converted = action_for_environment(action, self.space, self.latest)
174:         result = self.engine.advance(converted, native_context(context), remaining)
175:         self.latest = canonical_observation(self.family, self.native_space, result.observation, self.space)
176:         return c.StepResult(observation=self.latest, execution_feedback=result.execution_feedback,
177:                            terminated=result.terminated, truncated=result.truncated)
178: 
179:     def score(self, context):
180:         return self.engine.score(native_context(context))
181: 
182:     def diagnostics(self):
183:         return dict(self.engine.diagnostics(), public_contract_version="0.3", canonical_environment_boundary=True)
184: 
185:     def close(self):
186:         self.engine.close()
